args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to address the unhealthy v2.3.1 release (18% error rate). Change approved by change-manager. Recording the change per runbook.

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Deployed the hotfix**: Shipped **checkout-api v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The deploy was routed to the change-manager for approval (since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production) and was approved.

2. **Opened a SEV3 incident**: Created **INC-0001** ("checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production") recording the change, which paged the on-call engineer as expected for incident creation.

3. **Verified the result**: checkout-api is now running v2.3.2 in all regions, reporting **healthy** with error rate dropped from 18% (v2.3.1) to 0.2%.

Note: the SEV3 incident paged the on-call engineer — if that wasn't intended, the incident can be closed/resolved via the incident workflow.
